tekst.Dom kulture u vlasništvu Općine; njime u: Community centre owned by the municipality and managed by KRC Bilje. Contact KRC to use the premises.
tekst.Posjećenost portala mjerimo bez kolačića: We measure visits without cookies and without personal data: only aggregate daily counters are recorded (how often the portal was opened, in which language, on what type of device, and which layers and stories were turned on). No IP address or identifier is recorded, so no visitor can be recognised from these numbers. If “Do Not Track” is enabled in your browser, your visit is not counted. Aggregate figures are published in the portal’s annual report.
